⏱️ The SAT changes difficulty while you take it

Here's how the adaptive Digital SAT actually works, and why Module 1 matters most.

✅ Reading & Writing: 2 modules × 27 questions × 32 min.
✅ Math: 2 modules × 22 questions × 35 min.
✅ Desmos calculator built into all of Math.
✅ Module 1 decides Module 2.
✅ A hard Module 2 is usually good news.
✅ Don't rush it.
